userStories.title: Retune the spine anomaly detector's models to the spine's actual event/span/sequence semantics
userStories.description: As an LCA operator, I want the spine anomaly detector to stop firing dozens of false positives on healthy runs, so its warnings are trustworthy signal instead of noise that trains operators to ignore real anomalies.
acceptanceCriteria: _check_stalled no longer trips on legitimate sequence gaps (model per-producer sequences or an explicit gap allowance); _check_collision only trips when the same span_id is open twice concurrently (reuse across related events is normal); _check_cycle distinguishes per-event EPs (runtime.reducer.apply fires once per event by construction) from per-turn EPs via per-EP baselines
The 4-scenario runtime verification script (basic / tool-call / two sequential runs / non-converging) emits zero anomaly warnings on the healthy scenarios, or documents an explicit allowlist
New tests pin each detector against realistic streams (gapped sequences, reused span_ids, per-event EPs); existing anomaly deriver tests green; thresholds stay public/named; ruff check clean
userStories.notes:
Strength: Worth exploring. Runtime verification (mandatory step): this round's mock-LLM runs emitted dozens of anomaly_detector warnings on HEALTHY completed runs — stalled (sequence gaps are normal: multiple producers/filters), collision (span_ids like lca-seq-00000007 are reused across related events, not unique per span), cycle (consecutive_count=2 on runtime.reducer.apply, which fires once per event by construction — a guaranteed false positive). Extends the 2026-10-07 P2 observation. Deletion test: concentrates (the 'what counts as anomalous' model belongs in the detector, not in operators' heads).

Learnings (2026-10-08 optimize): retuned with measured data, not guesses. 4-scenario runtime verification BEFORE the fix: 37/278/193/188/356 false warnings on A/B/C1/C2/D. Forensics: (1) span_ids are per-run sequence-derived (lca-seq-*) and never closed -- cross-run reuse tripped both old and naive-new collision models; fix = run-scoped state reset in on_event (sequences, open spans, cycle counters) + collision only on .start-while-open via _check_stuck's table (collision ordered before stuck); (2) gaps: healthy max 69 -> STALLED_GAP_ALLOWANCE=128, plus non-positive-gap re-baseline; (3) cycle: per-EP baselines -- llm.stream.token=10_000 (streaming is the healthy shape), runtime.reducer.apply=32 (healthy max ~8), body.tool.execute.end=8, default stays 2. AFTER: zero anomaly warnings on all 5 scenario runs. Tests: 34 anomaly + 116 spine green; ruff clean. test_check_stalled_trips_on_sequence_gap became test_check_stalled_trips_on_huge_sequence_gap (old gap=5 no longer trips, as designed).
